critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx: logoTo = home ?? (nav ? '/workspace' : null) — correctly renders a Link only when a destination exists, otherwise a plain span with data-testid=brand-name; prevents an unlinked logo on nav=false pages that don't pass home.

useDialogFocus: focuses startRef (heading, tabindex=-1) on mount, traps Tab/Shift+Tab between first and last focusable inside boxRef (treating startRef as 'first' on Shift+Tab wrap), handles Escape via onEscape, and restores focus to opener or restoreSelector on unmount — matches spec. One subtle note: Shift+Tab from the startRef heading uses `document.activeElement === startRef.current` to wrap to last, but Tab from heading forward is handled by the browser naturally since heading has tabindex=-1 is excluded from tab order. Verified by code review — I could not simulate End-button click interactively because /device-test attempt stays in status='pending' (Test stream) and Start/End are disabled until a camera+WebSocket stream is active; DOM `removeAttribute('disabled')` + synthetic click did not fire the React onClick handler, consistent with how React 18 checks disabled on button elements regardless of attribute presence. Behavior is otherwise validated via the same hook powering demo and TeachWalk CancelConfirm and matches the spec in code.
useTitle: sets `${title} · Between Visit` on mount and restores to 'Between Visit' when title is falsy — all tested pages produced unique titles.

App.js routes: '/' and '/research' use Layout nav={false} home='/' (logo -> '/'); '/demo' and '/replay/:id' same; '/workspace' and all /clients, /routes, /review paths fall into the Workspace layout with nav=true (logo -> '/workspace'). Order of routes is correct — the wildcard '*' falls through to Workspace which has its own nested <Routes>. '/' is listed below '/demo' and '/replay/:id', which is fine because '/' only matches exact.

Landing.jsx: single h1, three steps rendered from a const, both buttons use Link (client-side nav), research-line uses external <a> for CDC and ACVREP — no target=_blank is set; consider adding rel='noopener noreferrer' when they add target='_blank' in the future, but as-is same-tab navigation is correct.

Research.jsx: validating list uses an empty
    plus a

    'Nothing listed yet.' — screen-reader users will hear the h2 and the empty list then the paragraph. Fine for now; when items are added, the

    should be hidden.

Footer disclaimer is centralised in Layout.FOOTER_TEXT and rendered via

on every Layout render — single source of truth.
Nav list in Layout.NAV correctly limited to [['/clients','Clients'],['/routes','Routes']] — Device test removed as required.
